title: 微機電壓力感測器製程
summary: 從壓力定義、電容讀出到氣壓與高度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pressure definition and Capacitive readout to Pressure and altitude: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 壓力定義 → 厚度靈敏度
stages.description: 把「壓力定義」「膜片彎曲」「厚度靈敏度」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Pressure definition, Diaphragm bending, Thickness sensitivity.

steps.title: 壓力定義：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「壓力讀值必須指定參考側」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Pressure readings require a reference side.
steps.instruction: 畫絕對、表壓與差壓的兩側邊界。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both sides for absolute, gauge and differential pressure. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 壓力讀值必須指定參考側；氣壓變動會改變表壓參考。
steps.observationEn: Pressure readings require a reference side; Ambient changes alter gauge references.
steps.failure: 若採用「沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing all pressures without reference definitions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「壓力定義」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：壓力讀值必須指定參考側。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Pressure definition diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Pressure readings require a reference side.

knowledge.title: 壓力定義／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：壓力讀值必須指定參考側。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Pressure readings require a reference side.

knowledge.title: 壓力定義／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Comparing all pressures without reference definitions.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「微機電壓力感測器製程」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「壓力定義：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：靈敏度提升可能降低量程、線性或過載強度。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「特殊元件工坊：功率、光電與 MEMS」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：微機電壓力感測器製程 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「靈敏度提升可能降低量程、線性或過載強度」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use MEMS pressure-sensor processing as the task boundary. After reading “Pressure definition: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Higher sensitivity can reduce range, linearity or overload strength. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Special-device workshop: power, optoelectronics and MEMS”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for MEMS pressure-sensor processing: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Higher sensitivity can reduce range, linearity or overload strength” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力定義」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Pressure definition, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 壓力讀值必須指定參考側
沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力
把中心位移直接等同邊緣應力
optionsEn: Pressure readings require a reference side
Comparing all pressures without reference definitions
Equating center displacement with edge stress
quiz.explanation: 壓力讀值必須指定參考側；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure readings require a reference side. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 壓力定義：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Comparing all pressures without reference definitions.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「壓力定義」成果，先指出錯誤主張「沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：氣壓變動會改變表壓參考。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Pressure definition artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Comparing all pressures without reference definitions". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Ambient changes alter gauge references. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 壓力讀值必須指定參考側；氣壓變動會改變表壓參考。
steps.observationEn: Pressure readings require a reference side; Ambient changes alter gauge references.
steps.failure: 若採用「沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing all pressures without reference definitions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「壓力定義」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「氣壓變動會改變表壓參考」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Pressure definition, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Ambient changes alter gauge references" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 壓力定義／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：氣壓變動會改變表壓參考。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Ambient changes alter gauge references.

knowledge.title: 壓力定義／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「沒有參考側也可直接比較所有壓力」與「壓力讀值必須指定參考側」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Comparing all pressures without reference definitions" is not equivalent to "Pressure readings require a reference side"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: 膜片彎曲：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「最大位移位置與最大應力位置未必相同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Maximum displacement and stress need not coincide.
steps.instruction: 畫固定邊緣膜片的變形與應力分布。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw deflection/stress in a clamped diaphragm. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 最大位移位置與最大應力位置未必相同；膜片大變形可引入張力非線性。
steps.observationEn: Maximum displacement and stress need not coincide; Large deflection introduces tension nonlinearity.
steps.failure: 若採用「把中心位移直接等同邊緣應力」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
